question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a purple present, Bob has a teal present, Claire has a grey present, Dave has a black present, Eve has a brown present, Fred has a green present, and Gertrude has a gold present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Fred and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Eve swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Eve has the
Options:
(A) purple present
(B) teal present
(C) grey present
(D) black present
(E) brown present
(F) green present
(G) gold present
solution:
Present colors in holder order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (purple, teal, grey, black, brown, green, gold)
1. Fred swaps with Alice: (green, teal, grey, black, brown, purple, gold)
2. Dave swaps with Alice: (black, teal, grey, green, brown, purple, gold)
3. Claire swaps with Dave: (black, teal, green, grey, brown, purple, gold)
4. Fred swaps with Claire: (black, teal, purple, grey, brown, green, gold)
5. Bob swaps with Dave: (black, grey, purple, teal, brown, green, gold)
6. Gertrude swaps with Fred: (black, grey, purple, teal, brown, gold, green)
7. Bob swaps with Eve: (black, brown, purple, teal, grey, gold, green)
Eve holds the grey present, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
